item.title: Kate Middleton Rewears Gucci Gown to the BAFTAs 2026
item.description: Kate Middleton made her triumphant return to the awards ceremony in a blush pink Gucci gown that was already in her wardrobe.

item.title: See All the Winners From the BAFTAs 2026
item.description: One Battle After Another continued its awards season run, while Frankenstein was rewarded for its distinctive design.

item.title: Alysa Liu and Her 'I Don't Give a Damn' Aesthetic Have Captivated The World
item.description: With her extraordinary style and carefree attitude, gold medal winning Alysa Liu has brought a breath of fresh air to the Milan Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics.

item.title: Industry’s Myha’la and Marisa Abela on Fighting, Friendship, and Platonic Kissing in the Club
item.description: Although Harper and Yas danced the night away in season four’s penultimate episode, the Industry stars tease that “there’s plenty of time for things to go wrong” ahead of the season four finale.

item.title: Meet Marc Toberoff, Elon Musk’s Hollywood-Loving Lawyer Facing Off Against Sam Altman
item.description: A key figure in Silicon Valley’s battle royale is a Malibu lawyer who’d rather be a movie producer—if only his name didn’t send some studio brass into fits. Tom Dotan sits down with the ultimate overlord’s underdog.

item.title: Outcry Roils BAFTAs After Guest With Tourette Syndrome Shouts N-word at Michael B. Jordan and Delroy Lindo
item.description: Lindo told Vanity Fair afterward that he and Jordan “did what we had to do” while presenting—but that he wished “someone from BAFTA spoke to us afterward.”

item.title: The Great Cosmetic Undoing Is Here
item.description: The legions who flocked to dermatologists and plastic surgeons to be filled and plumped are now seeking to reverse their procedures. Here’s what they’re getting un-done now.

item.title: Inside the Heartbreakingly Brief Life of Patrick Bouvier Kennedy, JFK and Jackie’s Youngest Son
item.description: In an excerpt from his new book, Twilight of Camelot: The Short Life and Long Legacy of Patrick Bouvier Kennedy, Steven Levingston tells the story of the Kennedys’ third child—his premature birth, the scramble to save him, and the media circus that erupted as Patrick’s life hung in the balance.

item.title: As Outlander Ends, Caitríona Balfe Enters a Brave New World—One She’s Long Been Building For Herself
item.description: After eight seasons of Outlander, Balfe talks to Vanity Fair about political advocacy, trading one beloved period romance for another with her role in Sense & Sensibility, and the advice she’d give to the stars of Heated Rivalry.
